Designed to hold this vibration all day, this bracelet keeps your energy aligned long after your generator turns off.

Why 963Hz? Because it’s the frequency of divine remembering. When you’re attuned to this range, mental clutter dissolves, your intuition heightens, and you reconnect to the inner clarity that guides your highest path. It’s not just a state of mind—it’s a field of awakening.

Benefits of Wearing This Frequency:

  • Clears energetic fog and restores mental clarity

  • Activates your pineal gland + higher perception

  • Strengthens your intuitive channel and connection to divine guidance

  • Raises your vibration to peace, purpose, and alignment

  • Keeps your energetic field clear, bright, and high-frequency

The Formula:

  • Ivory Jade – Infuses serenity, purity, and a calm connection to divine wisdom

  • White Crazy Lace Agate – Clears mental interference and harmonizes higher thought

  • Tibetan Quartz – Amplifies intuitive downloads and bridges spiritual dimensions

  • Clear Quartz – Amplifies, stabilizes, and stores energetic alignment

  • 5D Torus Charm – Generates infinite flow, coherence, and continuous energetic expansion

Together, these elements create a wearable field of illumination, mental clarity, and energetic elevation—helping you remember who you truly are and radiate that frequency into everything you do.
